scope: Development calibration; no TCP/loss/retransmission or exact browser scheduling model

transport_fit.method: Bounded robust fit: transfer_s = effective_RTT_factor*RTT + overhead + payload_bits/(capacity*efficiency)
transport_fit.fit_scope: Four fixed-policy development runs; outage-adjacent requests excluded. Adaptive cases not used for fit. No validation/test outcomes.
limitations: Phenomenological transport constants do not model TCP retries/loss/RTO
Fitted transfer residuals are not independent validation
Exact browser seek/scheduler behavior remains approximate

playable_cases_qualification: Diagnostic subset only; overloaded no-playback case remains in overall errors and final results
